instruction: Use the opened Autodesk Revit environment and its automation interfaces to export the completed model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The current model is an open structural hall with a regular column and beam rhythm. The facilities team wants an office and loading support bay added along one side while retaining the hall's structural order and open central volume.
source: Autodesk Revit 2025 API and IFC exporter
